distinct_contrasts: encoder/R2 and retraining-cadence contrasts are distinct later sealed designs; changes are never combined and attributed to downsampling
metrics: per-head pooled original-price MAE and the SHARED naive computed on exactly the intersection rows (sums/counts, never means of weekly means); relative error (MAE_h-naive_h)/naive_h, negative better
no_test: TEST rows never enter the comparison; development 2024 disclosure applies to both
population: intersection of the (origin row_id, head) pairs that are valid under BOTH designs' bundles, per split, on identical row ids; nothing outside the intersection enters either side of the comparison
reused_model_rule: a model trained on its own full TRAIN population and scored on the common support is labelled REUSED_MODEL_SUBSET_SCORE and is NOT a model trained on the common TRAIN population; that contrast would be a separate sealed design and identity
